name: Chained Oblivion
tagline: Finds the software you keep paying for and nobody uses
description: Goes through subscription spending looking for licences sitting idle, trials that quietly converted, two products doing one job, and charges nobody can account for. What comes back is a plain verdict on each line: drop it, keep it, or fold it into something else. Cancelling remains your call.
author: mjjefford
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
